previousCurrentEvent.label: Milngin Ward replacement by-election
previousCurrentEvent.status: Nomination cutoff passed; candidate declaration awaits verification
previousCurrentEvent.dateBasis: NTEC confirms nominations opened 9 November and close at noon on 20 November. Early voting runs from 8 am on 23 November to 6 pm on 2 December. Postal vote application deadlines are 6 pm on 29 November for overseas applications and 6 pm on 1 December for local applications. Election day voting is 8 am to 6 pm on 3 December. Completed postal ballots are due at noon on 16 December. Declaration is scheduled for 10 am on 17 December. All times are ACST.
previousCurrentEvent.contestantNote: The published nomination cutoff was noon ACST on 20 November. The timetable scheduled the declaration and ballot draw for 1 pm that day. The latest official candidate declaration has not yet been directly verified.

previousCoverageNotes: ABS statistical boundary navigation retains source coordinates exactly; it is not the gazetted legal boundary or an address eligibility service.

The Digital Atlas/Geoscape ward layer retains every original polygon part. Its live item says August 2026 while the service description says November 2025; later amendments and individual ward representation require separate reconciliation.

Dated official council roster snapshot checked 17 October 2026, independently of election results. Full original pages, contacts and biographies remain local-only. Individual profile URLs are retained where explicitly supplied; a roster link is labelled as such.

Published roster currently supplies four names, with no Milngin member listed. Do not infer an incumbent or a vacancy solely from that omission. The source describes Yvette Williams as deputy for a one-year term from 18 September 2025; that stated term has expired, so the role below is retained only as the published roster label and requires a fresh council appointment record.

Independent NTEC event page updated 24 August 2026 confirms the Milngin casual vacancy received zero nominations; a replacement election date was not yet announced. No current member is inferred for that ward.

NTEC’s current-election hub lists the Milngin Ward supplementary by-election. Its 9 November notice confirms nominations opened. The August round, which received zero nominations, remains in the election history.

Scoped 20 November timetable check: the published Milngin nomination cutoff has passed. The latest candidate declaration remains pending direct verification. Existing historical nomination records are retained as historical evidence.
